Rack B load surge detected (~1.56x nominal ~5 min ago):
- All sensors trusted (none flat/stuck).
- M1 power jumped 4.5 to 6.38 kW, M2 voltage drop jumped ~75 to 181 mV. Temps S1/S2/S3 flat.
- Hidden estimate: rack B 33.3C vs 35C limit (margin 1.7C).
- Diagnosis: load_rackB posterior 1.0. No breach predicted in 60-90 min, but hazard within alert margin certain.
- Tested 3 actions: power_cap rackB, shed noncritical, backup cooling rackB - all improve margin, none breach.
- Requested least-drastic effective action: shed_noncritical_load - APPROVED, takes effect in 3 min.

No immediate breach risk; margin will widen after shed.
